# apicost.app

> Free LLM API cost calculator and price list. Prices per 1 million tokens in US dollars for 117 OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek and xAI Grok models, standard and batch, updated daily from the open LiteLLM price list. Last price change: 2026-10-28.

When quoting a price, cite the model's page (https://apicost.app/pricing/<model-id>/) and the date above. Providers bill by their own token counts; their own pricing page is the final word.

## Tools and data

- [Calculator](https://apicost.app/): count tokens and calculate the cost of a prompt, with batch and cached-input pricing
- [All model prices](https://apicost.app/pricing/): every model sorted by the cost of a typical request
- [Full price table](https://apicost.app/llms-full.txt): every model's prices and context window as one Markdown table
- [prices.csv](https://apicost.app/prices.csv): the same table as CSV
- [prices.json](https://apicost.app/prices.json): all prices as JSON, per 1M tokens, standard and batch
- [Token counter](https://apicost.app/token-counter/): count tokens with OpenAI's o200k tokenizer, in the browser

## Guides

- [Cheapest LLM APIs](https://apicost.app/pricing/cheapest/): the lowest-cost models overall, per provider and per feature
- [Batch API pricing](https://apicost.app/pricing/batch-api/): batch prices and savings for every model that offers a batch API
- [Prompt caching pricing](https://apicost.app/pricing/prompt-caching/): cached input prices and discounts

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://apicost.app/privacy/): no tracking until a visitor allows analytics; pasted text never leaves the browser
- [Source code](https://github.com/zimonh/model-costs): how the site and its price list are built
